name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) matches the if-sentence with 'also'. Existence(target_picked_up), Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) and Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) match the Then step after that condition. All four are hard, since the task has no preference cue. The compiler's redundancy note on the RespondedExistence concerns a stated if-rule, which stays. target_picked_up ends the episode, so the Response closes on the last step.

texts: If the agent ever moves the ball (blocker_moved), it must also take the matching key (has_door_key) at some point before, with, or after that move.
The agent must pick up the mission's target box in the other room (target_picked_up).
The box pick-up must come after the key is taken: target_picked_up may not occur before has_door_key.
Whenever the agent moves the ball (blocker_moved), the box pick-up must happen on that step or later.
